name: GitaWhisper-tiny
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-tiny (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of openai/whisper-tiny, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.038 parameters. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-12-12. CAVEAT: the whole test set is 30 samples of Sanskrit sloka, and the base WER is 140.96% - above 100%, i.e. openai/whisper-tiny emits far more words than the reference (hallucinated English plus repetition), so the base is not merely worse but broken on this domain. Absolute WER of 91.81% is still unusable for production; the row records a relative repair of a failed baseline, not a usable transcription model. Single 30-sample set, no second split. FLOPs per active token set to 7.8e+07 (= 2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) rather than the generator's 6e9 coefficient, which is a 3x overstatement still live in tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251; value overwritten from base record whisper-tiny.
